title: Black Belt · Mockup A — the roster row ⋯ (BB3 · BB9 · BB6)
subtitle: Drawn on the real preview screens (fake data, Spring 2027, admin). What changes: the row ⋯ gets Edit payment and Undo payment for the latest payment (BB3); one order in three groups — the person · the money · taking someone off (BB9, Color Belt's order, v1.011); Remove candidate becomes two items, Withdraw and Delete permanently (BB6, v1.007). One question: on tablets and phones, where does Record payment go? (On a PC it is a button on the row, so it isn't in the ⋯.)

items.caption: PC, Mia Chen (paid in full, one $870 card payment). No Edit / Undo payment; one Remove candidate opens a box with Withdraw or Delete.
PC, a withdrawn row (Owen Price): Restore first.
Tablet 820 touch, Sam Lee ($660 still due). Record payment is the first item.

columns.label: Option 1 · Record payment stays first

items.caption: PC (the four PC menus are the same in both options). Edit payment · Undo payment act on the latest payment. Delete permanently is grayed with its reason while there are payment records (v0.904) or grades (v0.950).

PC, overpaid: Record refund in the money group, after Undo payment. (The menu opens above the row when there's no room below, as today.) Found: “Record refund · $50 overpaid” is 2 px wider than the 200 px menu, today too; the build makes it fit.
PC, no payment and no grades: nothing to edit or undo, so no Edit / Undo payment; Delete permanently is red and asks first (mockup D).
PC, withdrawn: Record refund · Print receipt — Restore · Delete permanently. Restore takes Withdraw's place in the last group (Color Belt's roster does the same).
Tablet: Record payment first in the whole menu, as today, with a line under it; the money group below.

row.caption: 320: the sheet scrolls for Delete and Cancel

columns.note: Green: what's new. Pro: the most-used item stays where staff find it today, the top. Con: the money is split — Record payment alone at the top, Edit / Undo / receipt in the middle — so touch screens get a fourth group and an exception to the one order (v1.011).

columns.label: Option 2 · first in the money group (recommended)

items.caption: PC, no payment, no grades (same in both options).
Tablet: Record payment opens the money group: Record · Edit · Undo · Print receipt.

row.caption: 320: the sheet scrolls for Delete and Cancel

columns.note: Green: what's new. Pro: every money item in one place and the same three groups on every screen size (v1.011); Edit details first, as on the PC. Con: on tablets and phones Record payment moves down two places (1st → 3rd), so staff used to tapping the top item have to look once.

footer: Who sees what (unchanged rules): Edit payment, Undo payment, refunds, Withdraw and Delete permanently are admins only. Staff see Edit details · Change plan or Kukkiwon (grayed once a payment is recorded, "… Ask an admin.") — Print receipt, plus Record payment in the money group on tablets and phones (on a PC it's the row's button). With Hide private details on, the money items are left out. Edit / Undo payment on the row always act on the candidate's latest payment; older payments stay on each payment line's ⋯ in the detail. They gray with the detail's reasons: "Undo the returned-check mark first." or "A refund is recorded. Undo the refund first." Undo payment asks first and names the payment (mockup C). Delete permanently's other gray reason: "… has grades, so they can't be deleted. Withdraw them instead." The detail's own ⋯ is mockup B.
